docs.summary: The typed bag carried from [`OnReloadDetach`](#api~Prowl.Ember.IReloadAware~OnReloadDetach) on the outgoing instance to [`OnReloadAttach`](#api~Prowl.Ember.IReloadAware~OnReloadAttach) on the incoming one. Stored values are themselves migrated in between, so the incoming instance reads current side objects.
Keys in the order they were first set.
